Plot a constant-within-type-confounding test: each type's confounding jump over time

Source: R/plots.R
plot.rd_trendcell.Rd

One panel per type: its local-linear jump in each comparison period with its 95% interval, and a dashed reference line, the type's average jump (trend = "constant") or the least-squares line through its jumps (trend = "linear"). Under the null the points sit on the dashed line, up to sampling error.

Usage

# S3 method for class 'rd_trendcell'
plot(x, ...)

Arguments

x

an object returned by rd_trendcell().

...

unused.

Value

A ggplot object (ggplot2 must be installed).

See also

Other tests of the assumptions: plot.rd_compstable(), plot.rd_homog(), plot.rd_typecont(), plot_switchers(), rd_compstable(), rd_homog(), rd_trendcell(), rd_typecont()

Examples

tr <- rd_trendcell(rddid_sim_pv, y = "Y", x = "R", time = "year", id = "id", t_rd = 3)
if (requireNamespace("ggplot2", quietly = TRUE)) plot(tr)
